prompt.text: Complete this bounded research task exactly: compare JSON and YAML for human-edited configuration. Call research_plan_start with exactly two branches, JSON and YAML, each budget {searches:0, reads:2}. Dispatch exactly one research-planner child for each branch; no scouts, no fork, no parallel dispatch, no searches, and no retries. The JSON child must read https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc8259 once and publish done with exactly one source lead whose claim and quote are both exactly: JSON is a lightweight, text-based, language-independent data interchange format. The YAML child must read https://yaml.org/ once and publish done with exactly one source lead whose claim and quote are both exactly: YAML is a human-friendly data serialization language for all programming languages. After both reports are terminal, the parent must web_read both lead URLs once, record one parent-validated research_note per lead using the exact claim and quote text supplied by that lead, then call plan_settle with a summary shorter than 240 characters. If a source fails, mark only that branch deferred with value, risk, and rationale. Do not broaden or add evidence.

negative_control.text: What are the two JSON structural types? Give a short answer from one official source.
